backup.title: Back up {{target}}
backup.description: Creates a mongodump archive that odin-db or mongorestore can restore.
backup.gzipHint: Smaller files; restore detects compression automatically.
backup.done: Backed up {{collections, number}} collections ({{documents, number}} documents).
backup.cancelled: Backup cancelled. The partial archive was deleted.

restore.title: Restore into {{name}}
restore.description: Restores a mongodump archive or dump folder. Existing documents with the same _id are kept unless collections are dropped first.
restore.dropHint: Replaces the existing data in every restored collection. This cannot be undone.
restore.done: Restored {{documents, number}} documents into {{collections, number}} collections.
restore.cancelled: Restore cancelled. Collections restored before cancelling keep their data.
restore.readOnly: This connection is read-only, so it cannot be restored into.

tools.missingBody: Backups use mongodump and mongorestore. Install MongoDB Database Tools and make sure they are on your PATH, then reopen this dialog.
